french.example: Bonjour, comment allez-vous ? (Hello, how are you?)
Merci beaucoup pour votre aide. (Thank you very much for your help.)
Un café, s'il vous plaît. (A coffee, please.)
Au revoir, à demain ! (Goodbye, see you tomorrow!)
Oui, je comprends. (Yes, I understand.)
Non, merci. (No, thank you.)
Je voudrais de l'eau. (I would like some water.)
Le pain est frais. (The bread is fresh.)
La maison est grande. (The house is big.)
Le chien court dans le jardin. (The dog runs in the garden.)
Nous allons manger à midi. (We are going to eat at noon.)
Il faut boire de l'eau. (One must drink water.)
Je voudrais un thé. (I would like a tea.)
Combien ça coûte, ce livre ? (How much does this book cost?)
Pardon, où sont les toilettes ? (Excuse me, where is the bathroom?)
Je ne comprends pas, répétez lentement. (I do not understand, repeat slowly.)
Parlez lentement, s'il vous plaît. (Speak slowly, please.)
Aujourd'hui, il fait beau. (Today, the weather is nice.)
À demain ! (See you tomorrow!)
La famille habite à Lagos. (The family lives in Lagos.)

spanish.example: Hola, ¿cómo estás? (Hello, how are you?)
Muchas gracias por tu ayuda. (Thank you very much for your help.)
Un café, por favor. (A coffee, please.)
Adiós, hasta mañana. (Goodbye, see you tomorrow.)
Sí, entiendo. (Yes, I understand.)
No, gracias. (No, thank you.)
Quisiera agua, por favor. (I would like water, please.)
El pan está fresco. (The bread is fresh.)
La casa es grande. (The house is big.)
El perro corre en el jardín. (The dog runs in the garden.)
Vamos a comer a mediodía. (We are going to eat at noon.)
Hay que beber agua. (One must drink water.)
Quisiera un té. (I would like a tea.)
¿Cuánto cuesta este libro? (How much does this book cost?)
Perdón, ¿dónde está el baño? (Excuse me, where is the bathroom?)
No entiendo, repite despacio. (I do not understand, repeat slowly.)
Habla despacio, por favor. (Speak slowly, please.)
Hoy hace buen tiempo. (Today the weather is good.)
¡Hasta mañana! (See you tomorrow!)
La familia vive en Lagos. (The family lives in Lagos.)
